scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "web,api" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm --prefix services/api-gateway run start:dev"
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "web,api" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "powershell -Command 'cd apps/web; npm run dev'" "powershell -Command 'cd services/api-gateway; npm run start:dev'"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../../services/api-gateway && npm install
